code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
acc={"yeast_LSC2":("P53312","ADP","fungus"),"spombe_beta":("O94415","ADP","fungus"),
 "neurospora_beta":("Q9P567","ADP","fungus"),"aspergillus_beta":("A0A7R8AQL1","ADP","fungus"),
 "human_SUCLA2":("Q9P2R7","ADP","animal"),"celegans_SUCLA2":("P53588","ADP","animal"),
 "arab_beta":("O82662","ADP","plant"),"human_SUCLG2":("Q96I99","GDP","animal"),
 "pig_SUCLG2":("P53590","GDP","animal"),"celegans_SUCLG2":("P53589","GDP","animal"),
 "ecoli_SucC":("P0A836","ADP","bact"),"mtb_SucC":("P9WGC5","ADP","bact"),
 "thermus_tt_GDP":("P25126","GDP","bact")}
seqs={n:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.strip().split('\n')[1:]) for n,(a,c,g) in acc.items()}
def nw_map(a,b,match=2,mis=-1,gap=-2):
    n,m=len(a),len(b);H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));H[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap;H[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1];row=H[i];prev=H[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=match if ai==b[j-1] else mis
            row[j]=max(prev[j-1]+s,prev[j]+gap,row[j-1]+gap)
    i,j=n,m;A=[];Bq=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        s=match if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else mis
        if H[i,j]==H[i-1,j-1]+s:A.append(a[i-1]);Bq.append(b[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif H[i,j]==H[i-1,j]+gap:A.append(a[i-1]);Bq.append('-');i-=1
        else:A.append('-');Bq.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
    while i>0:A.append(a[i-1]);Bq.append('-');i-=1
    while j>0:A.append('-');Bq.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
    mp={};rp=0
    for ra,qb in zip(A[::-1],Bq[::-1]):
        if ra!='-':mp[rp]=qb;rp+=1
    return mp
ref="pig_SUCLG2";Q20=57
order=["pig_SUCLG2","human_SUCLG2","celegans_SUCLG2","thermus_tt_GDP",
       "yeast_LSC2","spombe_beta","neurospora_beta","aspergillus_beta",
       "human_SUCLA2","celegans_SUCLA2","arab_beta","ecoli_SucC","mtb_SucC"]
res={n:(seqs[ref][Q20] if n==ref else nw_map(seqs[ref],seqs[n]).get(Q20,'-')) for n in order}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,6.5))
for i,n in enumerate(order):
    aa=res[n]; spec=acc[n][2]+"/"+acc[n][1]
    color="#d62728" if aa=="Q" else ("#7f7f7f" if aa=="-" else "#1f77b4")
    ax.barh(i,1,color=color,edgecolor='k')
    ax.text(0.5,i,f"{n}  [{spec}]   20β = {aa}",va='center',ha='center',
            color='white',fontsize=10,fontweight='bold')
ax.axhline(3.5,color='k',lw=1.2,ls='--')
ax.text(1.02,1.5,"GDP-forming betas",va='center',fontsize=10)
ax.text(1.02,8,"ADP-forming betas\n(incl. ALL fungi)",va='center',fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticks([]);ax.set_xticks([]);ax.set_xlim(0,1.45);ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_title("SCS β guanine-specificity residue (pig Gln-20β, PMID:16481318)\n"
 "Gln(Q)=red → animal SUCLG2 GDP determinant | Pro(P)=blue=ADP state | '-' bacterial N-term gap\n"
 "Yeast Lsc2 & all fungi = Pro → ADP state. Bootstrap: yeast∉GDP clade 99%, all fungi∉GDP 86%",
 fontsize=9.5)
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig("lsc2_20beta_residue_map.png",dpi=130)
print("Residue at 20β by taxon:")
for n in order: print(f"  {n:18s} [{acc[n][2]:6s}/{acc[n][1]}]  {res[n]}")
print("\nFungi all Pro:", all(res[n]=='P' for n in ['yeast_LSC2','spombe_beta','neurospora_beta','aspergillus_beta']))
print("Animal SUCLG2 all Gln:", all(res[n]=='Q' for n in ['pig_SUCLG2','human_SUCLG2','celegans_SUCLG2']))
print("Thermus GDP-forming bacterial beta at 20β:", res['thermus_tt_GDP'],"(Pro, not Gln => bacterial GDP uses different mechanism)")
